site_type: Agent Skills catalog and implementation documentation with agent-tool ecosystem intelligence
audience: developers connecting agents to tools and resources through MCP
teams evaluating runtime compatibility, interoperability, and safety
editorial_territory: Help people create, evaluate, install, distribute, and safely operate reliable Agent Skills; connect agents to tools and resources through MCP; and understand material interoperability changes across Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and compatible runtimes.
conversion_action: select a skill and copy or run its runtime-specific install command

core: MCP specification, SEPs, registry, SDKs, security, and client adoption
material Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and compatible-runtime changes
Model and multimodal capability launches that enable useful skills, workflows, or evaluations
adjacent: A2A and other open interoperability standards when they change agent-to-tool or agent-to-agent workflows
news_watch.inclusion_rule: Discover concrete skill-building opportunities before assessing publication readiness. Missing owned evidence should produce a feasible experiment brief; rank opportunity priority separately from readiness. Surface material official changes even when not publish-ready.

excluded_surface: generic AI news blog or release-note rewrite feed
